entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: Nice to meet you.

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: I am the one they call Alibaba.

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: I want to ask you something.

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: You're a phantom thief,[n]aren't you?
entries.uk: Ти ж Фантомний Злодій,[n]чи не так?

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: Can you really steal hearts?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Who is this? Why does he know[n]that you're a phantom thief?
entries.uk: Хто це? Звідки він знає,[n]що ти Фантомний Злодій?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Is one of our teammates pulling a prank[n]on you?
entries.uk: Може, це хтось із наших[n]тебе розігрує?

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: There is someone whose heart[n]I would like you to steal.
entries.uk: Є людина, чиє серце[n]я прошу тебе викрасти.

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: But I'm not asking for charity.[n]Let's make a deal.
entries.uk: Але я не прошу милостині.[n]Укладімо угоду.

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: You wish to know about[n]Medjed, correct?

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: I can give you information[n]on them if the change of[n]heart is successful.
entries.uk: Якщо зміна серця вдасться,[n]ви отримаєте від мене[n]інформацію про них.

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: If you so desire, I can take[n]care of them as well.
entries.uk: А якщо забажаєте, я можу[n]й розібратися з ними.

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: Do you believe in my skills?

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: I can track down their accounts,[n]just as I have with yours.
entries.uk: Я можу вистежити їхні акаунти —[n]так само, як і ваші.

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: But this is all I can[n]prove at the moment.
entries.uk: Але наразі це все, що[n]я можу довести.

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: I've prepared the necessary[n]tool on my end.

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: Look forward to it.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Shouldn't you respond to it?
How should I respond...?
Who is this?
You got the wrong guy.
Is this a prank?
